sn46.42:1.1: rañño bhikkhave, cakkavattissa pātubhāvā sattannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti.
sn46.42:1.3: cakkaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, hatthiratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, assaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, maṇiratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, itthiratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, gahapatiratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, parināyakaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti.
sn46.42:1.4: rañño bhikkhave, cakkavattissa pātubhāvā imesaṃ sattannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti.
sn46.42:2.1: tathāgatassa bhikkhave, pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgaratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti.
sn46.42:2.3: satisambojjhaṅratanassa pātubhāvo hoti …pe… upekhāsambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti.
sn46.42:2.4: tathāgatassa bhikkhave, pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa imesaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgaratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hotīti.
